points.title: Southmere Lake
points.description: Southmere Lake appears in A Clockwork Orange as part of the film’s unsettling, open urban landscape.

audio.title: Title Music (A Clockwork Orange)
audio.note: Press play as you approach the lake.

points.title: Binsey Walk Elevated Pathways
points.description: These elevated walkways were designed to separate pedestrians from traffic.

audio.title: Wendy Carlos - Timesteps
audio.note: Play as you walk along the pathway.

points.title: Tavy Bridge
points.description: Tavy Bridge is one of the most recognisable locations from A Clockwork Orange.

audio.title: Beethoven Symphony No. 9
audio.note: Start before stepping onto the bridge.

points.title: Coralline Walk Housing Blocks
points.description: In Brazil, similar housing estates depict a world dominated by bureaucracy.

audio.title: Brazil Theme
audio.note: Notice the contrast between sound and space.

points.title: Thamesmead Waterfront
points.description: Children of Men uses locations like Thamesmead by layering subtle signs of control.

audio.title: Fragments of a Prayer
audio.note: Play at the waterfront and slow down.
